tips.text: HellGate lets you tune every module to your taste. For a full walkthrough, open the Manifesto guide in the HELLGATE_README folder.
NOTE To leave a menu, press [Space] (Jump). [Space] is also the Cancel button. To confirm an action, press [E].
RAGE The Rage meter fills when you: • deal damage • block or parry • kill enemies Rage drains passively during struggles. If Rage is above 50%, the MindBroken meter will rise.

MindBroken Mind Break directly affects how hard struggles feel. The higher it is, the harder it is to mash stamina while grabbed. MindBroken rises from: • H-struggles (passive) • some animations (faster growth) • passive growth when Rage is above 50% • missing up/down QTE arrows during a struggle

Rage Mode [G] — three tiers Tier 1 (~5s) — a strong combo up to 9 hits. Tier 2 (~10s) — same combo plus an instant grab escape. Idle ~5s and your mind starts to break. Tier 3 (~15s) — demon wings and the same advantages. While Rage is active you can't be knocked down or grabbed. If you're grabbed before activating it, the Rage bar drains very fast.

Basic controls [LMB] — attack (3-hit combo) [RMB] — block (works mid-air). On EASY, holding it fully blocks grabs [RMB]+[W] — parry [E] after a parry — Vengeance Strike (15 Rage, max 100) [F] — dodge (i-frames). On EASY costs 20 stamina [T] — Bullet-Time [G] — Rage Mode (3 tiers) [V] — combat camera (3 modes) [H] — faction relations Hold [E] 3s — lie down / surrender Hold [E] 6s — game over [ESC]+[Enter] — instant death [F1] — cheat menu (at your own risk) [F11] + RMB — hot-respawn enemies, traps, and events [Space] — back / exit

Parry: Hold block and tap [W] just before the hit lands to stun the enemy. Press [E] nearby for Vengeance Strike — slows time and deals heavy damage. Costs 15 Rage. Arrows and axes are reflected; magic is absorbed. Miss the timing and the attack or grab goes through.

Rage Mode: Press [G] for 9-hit sword combos with no fatigue. While Rage is active you can't be knocked down or grabbed, and you deal more damage. Keep fighting — idle too long and your mind starts to break.
Bullet-Time: Spend Rage with [T] to slow time. Every second drains Rage — and chips away at your mind.
Health Potion: Use a Health Potion to break free from a grab instantly.
Witch sense: Near traps, Aradia's witch sense can warn of an ambush. She also senses lethal traps nearby.
Block: Hold [RMB] to cut incoming damage and stop knockdowns and grabs. Works in mid-air too.
Rage escape: With Rage tier 2 or 3, press [G] while grabbed to break free. Watch the meter — Rage drains during a grab, and you may not have enough left.

Struggle Out: Fill your stamina to break free. 1) When you see Struggle Out — mash [LMB]. You can also mash [E]. 2) When left/right arrows [←] [→] appear — spam [A] / [D]. Each press builds stamina. Don't press anything if the prompt and arrows are gone — you'll lose stamina.

Risky escape: When yellow and red up/down arrows [↑] [↓] appear, they swap colors with each other. Hit the yellow arrow several times while the indicator is visible. Hits give more stamina, and a clean streak adds a bonus. Hitting red — or pressing when no arrows are shown — empties your stamina.

Dodge & Mercy: Dodge with [F] to avoid damage and trigger Mercy. If you stay near the enemy and don't attack during Mercy, faction standing rises by +5%. Standing at +68% or higher is friendly-neutral: that faction stops attacking on its own. To check faction standing, press [H].
Combat camera: Press [V] to cycle three modes: default → farther → even farther.

H-scene camera: In HellGate you can steer the camera during H-scenes. Arrow keys [↑] [↓] [←] [→] — smooth pan. [Space] — cycle zoom (several levels). The game doesn't always center on the animation — adjust the view by hand whenever you need.
